title: Major update — admin, load-outs, supplies, for-sale, support, damage, photos

changes.text: Admin role with user management and promotion controls.
Range Load Out builder with smart ammo suggestions from range visit history.
Supplies Needed tab with category, cost, check-off, and archive.
For Sale tab — list firearms/add-ons, mark sold, track sales with prices.
Support tab with Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and per-tab help docs.
Damage tracking per firearm with severity flag and dashboard tile.
Photo uploads for Firearms, Add-Ons, Range Log with file type & size validation.
Status pills on every firearm — Ready (green), Oil (orange), Maintenance (red), Damaged (lightning).
Insurance Manifest PDF export with serial, purchase price, current value, acquisition date.
Renamed tabs: Ammo→Ammunition, Accessories→Add-Ons, Maintenance→Up-Keep.
Up-Keep schedule expanded to 7 categories: cleaning, chamber, oil, tear-down, safe audit, optic, holster.
Email verification redirect now correctly handles live URL callbacks.
Admin role RLS policies no longer cause 500 errors due to recursion.

title: Maintenance tab, firearm photos & smart dashboard

changes.text: Maintenance tab with per-firearm last-cleaned and last-oiled date tracking.
Auto-flag rules: cleaning after range visits, oiling after time without firing.
Firearm photo uploads to Supabase Storage with display on cards.
Clickable dashboard stat cards that jump to relevant tabs.
Action Required cards on dashboard for cleaning, oiling, low ammo alerts.
Dashboard layout reorganized with stat grid and action cards.
Real email and password authentication via Supabase Auth.
Multi-device sync — data persists across devices and browser sessions.
Row Level Security (RLS) so only you can access your own data.
Cloud-hosted Postgres database for all inventory tables.
Supabase Storage for firearm photos, accessory photos, and range target photos.
Migrated from browser localStorage to cloud database — your data is now truly backed up.
Rebranded app from Armory to The Gun Shed with new visual identity.
Dark gunmetal/rust aesthetic with Oswald (headings) + Archivo (body) fonts.
Sidebar navigation with icon + label for clarity.
Card layout, spacing, and color palette improvements across all tabs.
Firearms tab with manufacturer, model, serial, caliber, type, and values.
Range Log tab to track every range visit, location, rounds fired, and notes.
Accessories tab for scopes, holsters, grips, magazines, and other gear.
Ammunition tab tracking caliber, type, quantity, and storage location.
Dashboard with collection stats and recent activity.
Search and sort on every tab with export to CSV and JSON.
